svg.title: Nursing assistant — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as nursing assistant, wearing a care tunic. Visible work cue: A blood-pressure cuff connects through an open hose to a round pressure gauge with a single needle. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: side-swept hair, a softly squared face.
